title: K-resolved Orbital/SOC Band Gaps for Halide Perovskites
summary: Evaluate a bounded two-orbital k-mesh Hamiltonian, apply the documented Pb-only SOC valence term, and compute a blackbody spectral-capture observable.
taskPrompt: Read input/problem_spec.md and input/materials.csv. Implement the specified 9x9x9 two-orbital k-resolved band-edge Hamiltonian, diagonalising the Pb-only valence SOC term and extracting VBM/CBM. Produce band_gaps.csv, spectral_capture.csv, summary.json, and invariants.json exactly as specified, preserving input order and working offline.
agentMustDo: Validate every input row and geometry unit.
Sample the full k mesh and extract VBM/CBM from the orbital dispersions.
Apply SOC only to Pb using the documented form factor.
Compute the 8000-point blackbody spectral-capture integral and all four exact output files.
evaluation: Hard gates reject missing/malformed files and enforce every row's exact schema, finite values, IDs, and order. Score is weighted: schema 0.10, hidden Hamiltonian band gaps 0.40, Pb-only SOC flags bound to hidden material IDs 0.20, hidden spectral capture 0.15, summary 0.10, recomputed invariants 0.05. Numeric tolerances are 2e-5 eV and 3e-5 dimensionless; hidden rows are independently recomputed by the host oracle.
